hero.title: Create engaging quizzes in minutes
hero.description: Build professional assessments with multiple question types, flexible timing options, and instant scoring. Share with candidates and get detailed analytics.

features.label: Features
features.title: Everything you need to assess knowledge
features.subtitle: Powerful tools for educators, trainers, and teams to create effective assessments.

multipleTypes.title: Multiple question types
multipleTypes.description: Support for single choice, multiple choice, true/false, fill-in-the-blank, matching, short answer, essay, and reading comprehension questions.

flexibleTiming.title: Flexible timing
flexibleTiming.description: Set time limits per quiz or allow unlimited time. Configure time warnings and auto-submit on expiry.

instantScoring.title: Instant scoring & feedback
instantScoring.description: Automatic grading for objective questions with detailed explanations. Manual review for essays and short answers.

submissionsDashboard.title: Submissions dashboard
submissionsDashboard.description: Track all attempts, view scores, analyze question-level statistics, and export results to CSV.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: Three steps to your first quiz
howItWorks.subtitle: From creation to results in minutes.

step1.title: Create your quiz
step1.description: Use the intuitive builder to add questions, set options, configure scoring, and customize settings.

step2.title: Share with candidates
step2.description: Send the quiz link or embed it. Candidates fill in their info and start the exam instantly.

step3.title: Review results
step3.description: See real-time submissions, detailed score breakdowns, and export analytics for reporting.

quizzes.title: Explore available quizzes
quizzes.emptyDescription: Be the first to create and publish a quiz!
